title: Ultra Low-Latency Network & Packet Tweak
instructions:
=== ULTRA LOW-LATENCY NETWORK OPTIMIZATION GUIDE ===

OVERVIEW:
This optimization modifies Windows TCP/IP parameters, disables Nagle's Algorithm, removes CPU core parking bottlenecks, and tunes network queue depth for sub-millisecond packet pacing in competitive multiplayer games.

SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS:
- Operating System: Windows 10 / 11 (64-Bit Build 19041 or higher)
- Privileges: Administrator Rights required to write TCP Registry keys
- Network Interface: Ethernet LAN Connection recommended (Wi-Fi supported)

STEP-BY-STEP INSTALLATION:

Step 1: Download & Unpack Package
Click the DOWNLOAD NOW button to save the verified ZIP archive. Extract the contents to a folder on your Desktop.

Step 2: Create a System Restore Point (Recommended)
Before applying system-level network tweaks, create a Windows Restore Point:
1. Open Start menu, search for 'Create a restore point'.
2. Select your System drive (C:) and click Create.
3. Name it 'BrokenCheats Network Tweak Backup'.

Step 3: Execute Optimization Script
1. Right-click Network_Latency_Tweak.cmd and select Run as Administrator.
2. Press [1] in the terminal prompt to execute the Automated Registry Optimization.
3. The script will configure parameters:
   - TcpAckFrequency = 1 (Disables TCP Delayed ACKs)
   - TCPNoDelay = 1 (Disables Nagle's Algorithm)
   - NetworkThrottlingIndex = 0xffffffff (Disables Network Throttling)
   - SystemResponsiveness = 0 (Prioritizes Gaming I/O)

Step 4: Reboot PC & Enjoy Zero Lag
Restart your system to apply kernel registry values. Test your ping and input response in-game!
